name: Information Architecture
purpose: Design screen hierarchy, taxonomy, navigation trees, and progressive disclosure flows.
inputs: Content inventory, top user tasks, entity relationships, and current navigation graph
User vocabulary, card-sort and tree-test evidence, and content ownership
Depth, findability, accessibility, and progressive-disclosure thresholds
outputs: Validated taxonomy, labels, navigation tree, and cross-link map
Tree-test and first-click findings with ranked IA changes
stop_conditions: Critical tasks meet direct-success and depth thresholds in wayfinding tests
No orphan, dead-end, ambiguous label, or unlabeled icon remains
Token budget exhausted or required user-vocabulary evidence is unavailable
